description: American Heritage connects you with the people, documents, symbols and places that shaped the United States, and with the history of your own family and community.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Excerpts confirmed requirements 1, 2, 4 and 5; requirement 3 and any later requirements were not visible and are not outlined yet.
